title: Verification instructions are unclear after document rejection
statement: Customers who fail identity verification are being sent back to a generic onboarding page instead of a document-specific guidance page.
root_cause_hypothesis: The increase is concentrated among mobile applicants exposed to verification_reminder_v2 after their first document rejection. The reminder appears to route them to a generic onboarding page rather than document-specific requirements.
known_limitations: Product-event coverage is missing for 18 percent of affected customers.
Session replay is not connected yet, so page-level confusion is inferred from events and text evidence.

evidence.excerpt: Ich verstehe nicht, welches Dokument akzeptiert wird.
The reminder sends me back to the same generic page.

action_proposals.proposal: Create a Jira issue to route rejected-document users to a document-specific guidance page and update rejection copy.
Create a recovery task for currently blocked customers with approved support copy and callback option after 48 hours.
Draft an audience of customers with two verification failures in seven days, valid consent, and no fraud-review flag.
Recruit eight affected customers for a 30-minute validation study on document guidance clarity.

governance_checks.reason: Audience definition excludes customers without valid communication consent.
The proposal creates a behavior-derived intervention audience.
No sensitive categories are used in inclusion criteria.

title: Cancellation campaign reaches already-cancelled customers
statement: Customers who have completed cancellation are still receiving retention offers, creating complaints and avoidable support contacts.
root_cause_hypothesis: The retention journey appears to lag cancellation status updates by one batch cycle, so cancelled customers remain eligible for one additional send.
known_limitations: Campaign platform export includes send status but not final suppression reason.

evidence.excerpt: Ich habe bereits gekuendigt. Warum bekomme ich weiter Werbung?

action_proposals.proposal: Block activation until cancellation status is available as a hard suppression rule.
Create a data sync issue to reduce cancellation-status propagation delay below 15 minutes.

governance_checks.reason: Some affected profiles have no valid marketing consent after cancellation.
The action modifies eligibility for post-cancellation communication.
